title: Focus the Night experience
summary: Night Intelligence now stays compact when the roster is healthy, surfaces only meaningful attention, and turns Focus mode into a genuinely simplified night-time view around the existing personal Night hero.
changes: Replaces the large always-on Night Intelligence Command Centre presentation with a compact phase and freshness strip so the personal Night hero remains the primary view.

Removes the duplicate My Night, Attention and routine Review this night surfaces from the healthy-state presentation while keeping the underlying attention, conflict, freshness and troubleshooting engine active.
Surfaces the recommended Night Intelligence action only when an important roster warning or unresolved decision is present, reducing repeated information during a normal night.
Turns Calm Mode into a clearer Focus control and hides the whole-team Tonight section while Focus mode is active, leaving the nurse's own allocation and meaningful warnings visible.
Adds focused browser coverage for the compact iPhone presentation and the simplified Focus-mode hierarchy.
